q1.question: Is Nexxus CRM really free?
q1.answer: Yes! The Free plan is free forever with no credit card required. It includes up to 100 contacts, 50 deals, 50K AI tokens per month, and up to 3 team members. You can upgrade anytime as your business grows.

q2.question: How does the AI assistant work?
q2.answer: Our AI assistant analyzes your CRM data to provide insights, score contacts, draft follow-up emails, and predict deal outcomes. Just ask questions in natural language — like chatting with a knowledgeable team member who knows your entire pipeline.

q3.question: Can I import data from another CRM?
q3.answer: Absolutely. Nexxus CRM supports CSV import for contacts, companies, and deals. You can migrate your data from Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, or any other CRM in just a few clicks.

q4.question: Is my data secure?
q4.answer: Security is our top priority. We use enterprise-grade encryption, SOC 2 compliance, row-level security in the database, and regular security audits. Your data is stored in secure cloud infrastructure with 99.9% uptime SLA.

q5.question: Can I integrate with other tools?
q5.answer: Yes. Nexxus CRM integrates with WhatsApp Business, email providers, and more. We also support webhooks and API access on Pro and higher plans for custom integrations.

q6.question: What happens when I exceed my plan limits?
q6.answer: We'll notify you before you hit your limits. You can upgrade your plan at any time to get more contacts, deals, and AI tokens. We never delete your data — you just won't be able to add new records until you upgrade or free up space.

q7.question: Do you offer a discount for annual billing?
q7.answer: Currently we offer monthly billing. Annual billing with discounts is coming soon. Stay tuned for updates!
